Advanced reaction-state API¶

Most users should use the Core API. The interfaces below are for custom candidate selection or testing the engine-independent reaction-state logic.

.. py:class:: Candidate(reaction: ‘str’, nodes: ‘tuple[int, …]’) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl :canonical: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl.model.Candidate

.. py:function:: choose_candidates(state, n=300, rng=None) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: react(candidates, weights, state, reaction_path, top_k=30, pass_rate=0.5, rng=None) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

.. py:function:: simulate(model, total_steps, candidate_fn=, prob_fn=, candidate_n=300, top_k=30, seed=None) :module: chemfast.cg.reaction_dsl

These functions operate on graph/state data. They do not use particle coordinates or integrate molecular dynamics.
